text: possible to make a function that shows if its symetric based on the center of the radius
resolution: Added a live symmetry indicator to the Studio editor so asymmetry is caught at a glance rather than by hunting for a stray vertex. New pure symmetryReport(m, axis): places the symmetry plane at the bbox CENTRE on that axis ('centre of the radius' per the ask) and counts how many verts have no mirror twin there — 0 means symmetric, and a single drifted vertex reads as 2 (itself plus its now-orphaned twin). Studio shows it as a badge beside the symmetrize keep-+/keep- buttons: green '✓ symmetric X' when clean, red '⚠ N off X' when not; the axis follows the symmetrize axis (first enabled mirror plane, else X). It is memoized on the committed mesh id+version+axis so camera drags don't recompute it. Verified: editMesh suite 64/64 (clean box = 0 off, drift detected, symmetrize clears it back to 0), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed 2bbe04d55.
